name: D2
notes: 2026-11-01: Diagram language with a Go CLI producing SVG, PNG and PDF; native SVG labels rasterise cleanly with resvg.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it a strong candidate.
2026-11-24: Toolkit guide skills/d2/SKILL.md written from d2-diagram-svg evidence (D2 0.7.1, macOS arm64, four-node LR chain to SVG); other layouts, themes and formats untested.

evidence.result: Generated 12650-byte SVG (viewBox 0 0 859 268); Source, Layout, SVG and Inspect labels present; 4 shape groups and 3 edge paths; repeat and fresh-process SHA-256 identical; 960 px raster showed four boxes, three arrows, no clipping.
evidence.scope: Four-node left-to-right chain to SVG with D2 0.7.1 on macOS arm64: labels, shape and edge counts, repeat byte-identical. Not other layouts, formats or platforms.

summary: A text-based diagram language and CLI that lays out diagrams and exports SVG, PNG or PDF. Its main advantage is editable source with automatic layout for architecture and flow diagrams.
use_when: Generate editable diagrams from concise text descriptions
Prefer over Graphviz when D2 syntax and layout are a better fit
avoid_when: Use Graphviz for DOT compatibility or its mature layout options
Use Mermaid for diagrams embedded in Markdown

assessment.rationale: Official repository was reviewed, but a current release or dated maintenance signal could not be established from the sources read; retain as a candidate pending version/maintenance confirmation.
